name: What factors should I consider when choosing cabinet hardware for a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing cabinet hardware for a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When undertaking a whole-home remodel, selecting cabinet hardware involves considering aesthetic continuity, functionality, and the overall design vision for your updated living spaces. Factors include the style of your home (e.g., modern, traditional, transitional), the finish of your fixtures and appliances, and the ergonomics of the hardware itself. We guide clients through these decisions as part of our integrated design-build process, helping them choose hardware that enhances both the beauty and daily usability of their customized renovations, ensuring consistent quality throughout the home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your home's style, fixture finishes, and hardware ergonomics to ensure aesthetic continuity and functionality across your whole-home remodel.
